answer: Each challenge commits to a task instance whose salt is derived only after a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse from drand quicknet is published. Because that pulse is unpredictable and unbiasable until quorum signatures exist, an automated sybil swarm cannot precompute answers, stockpile valid work, or select favorable identities offline. Whether a node names lagoon, island, or juniper, its commit-reveal response remains bound to the authenticated pulse and a rate-limited identity.
